```{r Setup, echo = FALSE,  warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidybayes)
```

### Plot TB prevalence 

```{r Plot prevalence data, height = 8, width =11}
ggplot() +
    geom_point(data=bactModelNatDF1 %>% 
                   mutate(label = paste(study.country, study.end.year)), 
              aes(x=reorder(label, tbPrev), y=tbPrev*1e5, group=Sex, color=Sex), size=2) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=14) + theme(legend.position = "none",
                            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) +
    facet_wrap(vars(Sex)) + ggtitle("Reported sex-stratified TB prevalence by survey") +
    coord_flip() + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c("darkred", "dodgerblue4"))+
    ylab("Reported bacteriologically confirmed TB prevalence (per 100,000)") + 
    xlab("") 

ggplot() +
    geom_point(data=bactModelNatDF1 %>% 
                   mutate(label = paste(study.country, study.end.year)), 
              aes(x=reorder(label, tbPrevSE), y=tbPrevSE*1e5, group=Sex, color=Sex), size=2) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=14) + theme(legend.position = "none",
                            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) +
    facet_wrap(vars(Sex)) + ggtitle("Survey standard error of prevalence")+
    coord_flip() + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c("darkred", "dodgerblue4"))+
    xlab("") 
```

## Format notification data

```{r Notification Data, echo = FALSE,  warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, width=11.5, height=8.5}
##### NOTIFICATION DATA ##############################################
notif00 <- read.csv(here("data/covariates/TB_notifications_2025-12-19.csv"))

##### POPULATION DATA ##############################################
sexPop0 <- read.csv(here("data/covariates/un_population_data.csv"))

sexPop <- sexPop0 %>%
          mutate(male = as.integer(gsub(" ", "", male))*1e3,
                 female = as.integer(gsub(" ", "", female))*1e3) %>% 
          rename(country = study.country, 
                 year = study.end.year,
                 pop_male = male, 
                 pop_female = female)

sexPop[grep("Viet", sexPop$country), "country"] <- 
    notif00[grep("Viet", notif00$country), "country"] <- "Vietnam"
sexPop[grep("Lao", sexPop$country), "country"] <- 
    notif00[grep("Lao", notif00$country), "country"] <- "Laos"
sexPop[grep("People's", sexPop$country), "country"] <- 
    notif00[grep("People's", notif00$country), "country"] <- "North Korea"
sexPop[grep("Gambia", sexPop$country), "country"] <- 
    notif00[grep("Gambia", notif00$country), "country"] <- "Gambia"
sexPop[grep("Tanzania", sexPop$country), "country"] <- 
    notif00[grep("Tanzania", notif00$country), "country"] <- "Tanzania"


#### Convert to male-to-female ratios 
notif0 <- notif00 %>% 
         filter(year > 1993) %>%
         select(country, g_whoregion, 
                year, 
                newrel_m15plus,
                newrel_f15plus, 
                new_sn_m15plus, new_ep_m15plus, 
                new_sp_m1524, new_sp_m2534, 
                new_sp_m3544, new_sp_m4554,
                new_sp_m5564, new_sp_m65, new_sp_mu,
                new_sn_f15plus, new_ep_f15plus, 
                new_sp_f1524, new_sp_f2534, 
                new_sp_f3544, new_sp_f4554,
                new_sp_f5564, new_sp_f65, new_sp_fu, 
                c_newinc, new_sp) %>% 
### Setup to use 2023 population for Cambodia
         mutate(year = ifelse(year == 2024 & country == "Cambodia", 
                                        2023, year)) %>% 
         left_join(sexPop) %>%
         mutate(year = ifelse(year == 2023 & country == "Cambodia" & c_newinc == 33779, 
                                        2024, year), 
                pop_both = pop_male + pop_female,
                cases_male0 = newrel_m15plus,
                # allCases_male0 = newrel_m15plus,
                cases_female0 = newrel_f15plus,
                # allCases_female0 = newrel_f15plus,
                cases_both0 = c_newinc, 
                smrCases_male0 = new_sp_m1524 + new_sp_m2534 + new_sp_m3544 + new_sp_m4554 + new_sp_m5564 + new_sp_m65, 
                smrCases_female0 = new_sp_f1524 + new_sp_f2534 + new_sp_f3544 + new_sp_f4554 + new_sp_f5564 + new_sp_f65, 
                smrCases_both0 = new_sp)

### for some reason if else wouldn't work so let' just loop 
for (i in 1:nrow(notif0)){
    if (is.na(notif0$cases_male0[i]) & notif0$year[i] < 2013){
        notif0$cases_female0[i] <- sum((notif0 %>% select(contains(c("sn_f", "sp_f"))))[i,], na.rm = T)
        notif0$cases_male0[i]   <- sum((notif0 %>% select(contains(c("sn_m", "sp_m"))))[i,], na.rm = T)
        
        notif0$allCases_female0[i] <- sum((notif0 %>% select(contains(c("sn_f", 
                                                                        "sp_f", "ep_f"))))[i,], na.rm = T)
        notif0$allCases_male0[i]   <- sum((notif0 %>% select(contains(c("sn_m", 
                                                                        "sp_m", "ep_m"))))[i,], na.rm = T)
    }
}

### Calculate male - female notification ratio and apply to total notifications 
notif0 <- notif0 %>% 
          group_by(country) %>% 
          mutate(cases_female = ifelse(cases_female0 == 0, NA, cases_female0),
                 cases_male = ifelse(cases_male0 == 0, NA, cases_male0),
                 smrCases_male = ifelse(smrCases_female0 == 0, NA, smrCases_female0),
                 smrCases_female = ifelse(smrCases_male0 == 0, NA, smrCases_male0),
                 cases_both = ifelse(cases_both0 == 0, NA, cases_both0),
                 smrCases_both = ifelse(smrCases_both0 == 0, NA, smrCases_both0)) %>%  
          fill(cases_female, .direction = "downup")%>% 
          fill(cases_male, .direction = "downup")%>% 
          fill(smrCases_male, .direction = "downup")%>% 
          fill(smrCases_female, .direction = "downup")%>% 
          fill(smrCases_both, .direction = "downup")%>% 
          fill(cases_both, .direction = "downup")%>% 
          ungroup() %>% 
          mutate(
                 calcCases_male = cases_both * (cases_male / (cases_male + cases_female)),
                 calcCases_female = cases_both * (cases_female / (cases_male + cases_female)),
                 calcSmrCases_male = smrCases_both * (smrCases_male / (smrCases_male + smrCases_female)),
                 calcSmrCases_female = smrCases_both * (smrCases_female / (smrCases_male + smrCases_female)))

notifStrat <- notif0 %>% 
              pivot_longer(cols=c(pop_male, pop_female, pop_both,
                                 cases_male, cases_female,
                                 calcCases_male, calcCases_female,
                                 cases_both, 
                                 # allCases_male, allCases_female,
                                 smrCases_male, smrCases_female, 
                                 calcSmrCases_male, calcSmrCases_female), 
                          names_to = c("Measure", "Sex"), 
                          # names_prefix = "notifRate",
                          names_sep = "_",
                          values_to = "values",
                          values_drop_na = TRUE) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = Measure, 
                          values_from = values) %>% 
              mutate(### Poisson uncertainty
                     casesSE = sqrt(cases / pop),
                     ### Notification rate 
                     notifRate = cases/pop, 
                     calcNotifRate = calcCases / pop, 
                     # allnotifRate = allCases / pop, 
                     smrNotifRate = smrCases / pop,
                     calcSmrNotifRate = calcSmrCases / pop,
                     ### Notification rate uncertainty
                     notifRateSE = casesSE/pop, 
                     ### Log notification rate 
                     logNotifRate = log(notifRate), 
                     logCalcNotifRate = log(calcNotifRate),
                     logSmrNotifRate = log(smrNotifRate), 
                     logCalcSmrNotifRate = log(calcSmrNotifRate), 
                     ### Uncertainty in log notification rate
                     logNotifRateSE = log((cases + casesSE) / (cases-casesSE))/pop)  %>%
              select(country, year, Sex, pop, cases, casesSE, calcCases,# allCases,
                     notifRate, notifRateSE, calcNotifRate,# allnotifRate, 
                     logNotifRate, logCalcNotifRate, logNotifRateSE, 
                     smrNotifRate, logSmrNotifRate, calcSmrNotifRate, logCalcSmrNotifRate)


notifRatio <- notif0 %>% 
              mutate(notifRateMale = cases_male/pop_male, 
                     notifRateFemale = cases_female/pop_female, 
                     notifRateBoth = cases_both / pop_both, 
                     # notifRateBoth = (cases_female + cases_male) / (pop_female + pop_male), 
                     # allNotifRateMale = allCases_male/pop_male, 
                     # allNotifRateFemale = allCases_female/pop_female,
                     logNotifRateMale = log(notifRateMale),
                     logNotifRateFemale = log(notifRateFemale),
                     mfRatioNotif = notifRateMale/notifRateFemale,
                     logMfRatioNotif = log(mfRatioNotif)) %>% 
              rename(study.country = country, 
                     study.end.year = year) 

notifPrevRatio <- left_join(bactModelNatDF, notifRatio) %>% 
              mutate(notifRateMale = ifelse(notifRateMale==0, NA, notifRateMale),
                     # allNotifRateMale = ifelse(allNotifRateMale==0, NA, allNotifRateMale),
                     notifRateFemale = ifelse(notifRateFemale==0, NA, notifRateFemale),
                     # allNotifRateFemale = ifelse(allNotifRateFemale==0, NA, allNotifRateFemale),
                     
                     empPNMale = tbPrev_male / notifRateMale, 
                     # empAllPNMale = tbPrev_male / allNotifRateMale, 
                     empNPMale = notifRateMale / tbPrev_male, 
                     empPNFemale = tbPrev_female / notifRateFemale, 
                     # empAllPNFemale = tbPrev_female / allNotifRateFemale, 
                     empNPFemale = notifRateFemale / tbPrev_female, 
                     label = paste(study.country, study.end.year))

bactNotifStrat <- bactModelNatDF1  %>%
             select(id,
                    Sex,
                    tbPrev,
                    tbPrevSE,
                    logTbPrev,
                    logTbPrevSE,
                    study.country, 
                    WHO.region, 
                    study.end.year,
                    symptomsRequired, 
                    # `Adjusted Prevalence`,
                    # sex.analysis.indicator,
                    XpertCultUsed,
                    year_z) %>%
             rename(country = study.country,
                    year = study.end.year) %>%
             left_join(notifStrat %>% 
                      select(! contains("smr")), by=c("country", "year", "Sex")) %>%
             rename(study.country = country,
                    study.end.year = year) %>%
             mutate(notifRate = ifelse(notifRate==0, NA, notifRate))

smrNotifStrat <- bactModelNatDF1  %>%
             select(id,
                    Sex,
                    logTbPrev,
                    logTbPrevSE,
                    study.country, 
                    WHO.region, 
                    study.end.year,
                    year_z) %>%
             rename(country = study.country,
                    year = study.end.year) %>%
             left_join(notifStrat, by=c("country", "year", "Sex")) %>%
             rename(study.country = country,
                    study.end.year = year) %>%
             mutate(notifRate = ifelse(notifRate==0, NA, notifRate))


npRatioDF <- left_join(bactModelNatDF1  %>%
                         select(id, Sex,
                                tbPrev,
                                logTbPrev, 
                                logTbPrevSE,
                                study.country, 
                                WHO.region,
                                study.end.year, 
                                year_z), 
                       notifStrat) 

```

## Model 1: Sex-stratified TB prevalence only

```{r Sex-stratified Prevalence Model, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide", fig.height = 8, fig.width =11}

# default_prior(logTbPrev | se(logTbPrevSE, sigma=TRUE) ~ 
#                            1 + Sex + (1 + Sex | study.country) + (1 + Sex | id),
#               data = bactModelNatDF1)

tbPrevMod <- brms::brm(formula = logTbPrev | se(logTbPrevSE, sigma=TRUE) ~ 
                           1 + Sex + (1 + Sex | study.country) + (1 + Sex | id),
                       data = bactNotifStrat,
                       prior = c(prior(normal(0,1), class = Intercept),
                                 prior(normal(0, 1), class = b),
                                 prior(cauchy(0,1), class = sd),
                                 prior(cauchy(0,1), class = sigma),
                                 prior(lkj(10), class=cor)),
                       
                       family = gaussian(),
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                       chains = 4,
                       cores = 4,
                       iter = 10000, warmup = 2500, thin=3)

### posterior predictive check 
pp_check(tbPrevMod, ndraws=100)

### coefficients
summary(tbPrevMod)

### create model estimates 
survey_tb_prev_mod_est <-  tbPrevMod %>% 
    add_epred_draws(newdata = bactModelNatDF1 %>%  
                              mutate(logTbPrevSE = 0),
                    re_formula =  ~ 1 + Sex + (1 + Sex | study.country) + (1 + Sex | id), 
                    allow_new_levels=TRUE) %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(label = paste(study.country, study.end.year)) %>% 
    dplyr::select(label, study.country, id, Sex, .draw, .epred) %>%
    group_by(Sex, id, study.country) %>%  
    mutate(tbPrev = exp(.epred) * 1e5)

### Create summary statistics 
survey_tb_prev_mod_summary <- 
    survey_tb_prev_mod_est %>%
    group_by(Sex, study.country, id, label) %>%
    mean_qi(tbPrev, na.rm=T) %>% 
    mutate(across(c(tbPrev, .lower, .upper), 
                  round, 2)); survey_tb_prev_mod_summary
```

### Plot survey-level pooled prevalence estimates


### Total pooled M:F ratio of prevalence estimate

```{r}
tb_prev_mod_est <-  tbPrevMod %>% 
                          add_epred_draws(newdata = cntry_nd %>% distinct(),
                                          re_formula =  ~ 1 + Sex,
                                          allow_new_levels=TRUE) %>%
                            ungroup() %>% 
                            dplyr::select(study.country, Sex, .draw, .epred) %>%
                            group_by(Sex, study.country) %>%  
                            mutate(tbPrev = exp(.epred) * 1e5)

tb_prev_mod_summary <- 
    tb_prev_mod_est %>%
    select(!.epred) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = Sex, values_from = tbPrev) %>% 
    mutate(mfRatio = male/female) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mean_qi(mfRatio, na.rm=T) %>% 
    mutate(across(c(mfRatio, .lower, .upper), 
                  round, 2)); tb_prev_mod_summary
```

### Model 2: Sex-stratified TB prevalence + year 

```{r Sex-stratified Prevalence Model, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide", fig.height = 8, fig.width =11}
tbPrevYrMod <- brms::brm(formula = logTbPrev | se(logTbPrevSE, sigma=TRUE) ~ 
                           1 + Sex + (1 + Sex | study.country) + 
                          (1 + Sex | id) + Sex*year_z,
                       data = bactNotifStrat %>% filter(study.end.year !=1994) %>% 
                              mutate(year_z = study.end.year - mean(study.end.year)),
                       prior = c(prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept),
                                 prior(normal(0, 1), class = b),
                                 prior(cauchy(0, 1), class = sd),
                                 prior(cauchy(0, 1), class = sigma),
                                 prior(lkj(10), class=cor)),
                       family = gaussian(),
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                       chains = 4,
                       cores = 4,
                       iter = 10000, warmup = 2500, thin=3)

### check the fit 
# plot(tbPrevYrMod)

### posterior predictive check 
pp_check(tbPrevYrMod, ndraws=100)

### coefficients
summary(tbPrevYrMod)


check24prevdata <- bactNotifStrat %>% 
                  select(study.country, Sex) %>% 
                   distinct() %>% 
                   mutate(logTbPrevSE = 0, 
                          year_z = 2024 - 2013)


tb_prev24_mod_est <-  tbPrevYrMod %>%
```

### Model 3: Notification as an offset to estimate NP ratio 

```{r Sex-stratified Notification-to-Prevalence Ratio Model, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide", fig.height = 8, fig.width =11}
modelNP <- brms::brm(formula = logTbPrevNeg | se(logTbPrevSE, sigma=TRUE) ~ 
                              1 + Sex + (1 + Sex | study.country) + 
                             (1 + Sex | id) + offset(logCalcNotifRateNeg),
                       data =  bactNotifStrat %>% mutate(logTbPrevNeg = -1*logTbPrev,
                                                         logCalcNotifRateNeg = -1*logCalcNotifRate),
                       prior = c(prior(normal(0,1), class = Intercept),
                                 prior(normal(0,1), class = b),
                                 prior(cauchy(0,1), class = sd),
                                 prior(cauchy(0,1), class = sigma),
                                 prior(lkj(10), class=cor)),
                       
                       family = gaussian(),
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                       chains = 4,
                       cores = 4,
                       iter = 10000, warmup = 2500, thin=3)
```

#### Model performance checks 

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.height = 8, fig.width =11}
### check the fit 
plot(modelNP)

### posterior predictive check 
pp_check(modelNP, ndraws=100)

### coefficients
summary(modelNP)
```

#### Create model estimates
```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.height = 8, fig.width =11}
as.data.frame(modelNP) %>% select(b_Intercept, b_Sexmale) %>% 
                           mutate(npRatioFemale = exp(b_Intercept), 
                                  npRatioMale = exp(b_Intercept + b_Sexmale), 
                                  mfRatio = npRatioMale/npRatioFemale) %>%
                           mean_qi(npRatioFemale, npRatioMale, mfRatio) %>% 
                           mutate(across(c(npRatioFemale, npRatioFemale.lower, npRatioFemale.upper, 
                                           npRatioMale, npRatioMale.lower, npRatioMale.upper,
                                           mfRatio, mfRatio.lower, mfRatio.upper), 
                                  round, 2))
```

#### Create country notification-to-prevalence ratios 
```{r country np ratios}
##### Get the posterior draws including the country random effects
country_modNP_samps <-  as.data.frame(modelNP) %>% 
                        select(contains("r_study.country"), b_Intercept, b_Sexmale) %>% 
                        select(! cor_study.country__Intercept__Sexmale) 


colnames(country_modNP_samps) <- gsub("\\]", "", gsub("\\[", ",", colnames(country_modNP_samps)))

country_modNP_samps <- country_modNP_samps %>% 
pivot_longer(cols=`r_study.country,Bangladesh,Intercept`:`r_study.country,Zimbabwe,Sexmale`, names_sep = ",",
             names_to= c("variable", "study.country", "coefficient"), values_to="value") %>% 
select(!variable) %>% 
pivot_wider(id_cols = c(b_Intercept, b_Sexmale, study.country), names_from = coefficient, values_from = value, names_prefix = "cntry_reff_") 
    
    
country_modNP_est <- country_modNP_samps %>% 
                     mutate(npRatioFemale  = exp(b_Intercept + cntry_reff_Intercept),
                            npRatioMale = exp(b_Intercept + b_Sexmale + cntry_reff_Intercept + cntry_reff_Sexmale), 
                            mfRatio = npRatioMale/npRatioFemale) %>% 
                     group_by(study.country) %>% 
                     mean_qi(npRatioFemale, npRatioMale, mfRatio) %>% 
                     mutate(across(c(npRatioFemale, npRatioFemale.lower, npRatioFemale.upper, 
                                    npRatioMale, npRatioMale.lower, npRatioMale.upper,
                                    mfRatio, mfRatio.lower, mfRatio.upper), 
                                   round, 2)); country_modNP_est

country_modNP_est_f <- country_modNP_est[,1:4]; country_modNP_est_f$Sex <- "Female"
colnames(country_modNP_est_f)[2:4] <- c("Mean", "Lower", "Upper")
country_modNP_est_m <- country_modNP_est[,c(1, 5:7)]; country_modNP_est_m$Sex <- "Male"
colnames(country_modNP_est_m)[2:4] <- c("Mean", "Lower", "Upper")
country_modNP_est_b <- rbind(country_modNP_est_f, country_modNP_est_m) 
```

## Covariate analysis 

### Format covariate data

```{r covariate data, echo = FALSE,  warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
#### ART coverage data from UNAIDS
artCoverage0 <- read.csv(here("data/covariates/unaids-00_25-adult-art-coverage-sex.csv")) %>%
                pivot_longer(cols = X2000:X2025, names_to = "study.end.year", 
                             values_to = "art_coverage")  %>% 
                rename(study.country = Region) %>% select(!ISO3) %>% 
                mutate(study.end.year = as.numeric(gsub("X", "", study.end.year)))

#### Gender development index 
gdi0 <- read.csv(file=here("data/covariates/GenderDevelopmentIndex.csv")) %>%
        rename(study.country = Entity, study.end.year = Year, 
               gdi = Gender.Development.Index) %>% 
        select(study.country,study.end.year,gdi)

#### HIV prevalence, type 2 diabetes prevalence, alcohol use disorder prevalence
covariates00 <-  #read.csv(file=here("data/covariates/covariates_1994-2023.csv")) %>% 
                read.csv("~/Downloads/IHME-GBD_2023_DATA-7619198f-1/IHME-GBD_2023_DATA-7619198f-1.csv") %>%
                dplyr::rename(study.country = location, 
                              Sex = sex, 
                              study.end.year = year) %>%
                filter(metric == "Rate", 
                       measure == "Prevalence") %>% 
                select(study.country, study.end.year, Sex, cause, val) %>%
                pivot_wider(names_from = cause, values_from = val) %>% 
                mutate(Sex = ifelse(Sex == "Male", "male", "female"))

### BMI data from GBD 2023
bmi0 <- read.csv(file=here("data/covariates/IHME_GBD_2023_COV_1980_2023_ADULT_UNDERWEIGHT_Y2025M01D08.CSV")) %>%
        filter(year_id > 1999) %>%
        rename(study.country = location_name) %>%
        select(study.country, year_id, sex, covariate_name_short, mean_value) %>%
        mutate(Sex = ifelse(sex == "Male", "male", "female")) %>%
        rename(bmi = mean_value,
               study.end.year = year_id) %>% select(!c(sex, covariate_name_short))

### Smoking data from GBD 2023
smoking0 <- read.csv(here("data/covariates/IHME-GBD_2023_smokingData.csv"))  %>%
        rename(study.country = location_name) %>%
        mutate(Sex = ifelse(sex_name == "Male", "male", "female")) %>%
        select(study.country, year, Sex, val)  %>% 
        mutate(smoking = val * 100) %>% 
        rename(study.end.year = year)

uhc0 <- readRDS(here("data/covariates/uhcIndex.rds")) %>% 
    mutate(study.end.year = as.integer(study.end.year),
           UHCindex = UHCindex*100)

fitCovariates <-left_join(covariates00, bmi0) %>% 
                left_join(uhc0) %>% 
                left_join(smoking0) %>% 
                left_join(gdi0) %>% 
                mutate(study.end.year = ifelse(study.end.year == 2023 & 
                                               study.country == "Cambodia", 
                                               2024, study.end.year)) %>% 
                left_join(artCoverage0) %>% 
                #### Add in prevalence of untreated and treated HIV
                mutate(art_coverage = ifelse(is.na(art_coverage), 
                                                   0, art_coverage), 
                             trtdHIV =   `HIV/AIDS` * art_coverage, 
                             untrtdHIV = `HIV/AIDS` * (1-art_coverage))

fitCovariates[which(fitCovariates$study.country == "United Republic of Tanzania"), "study.country"] <- "Tanzania"
fitCovariates[which(fitCovariates$study.country == "Viet Nam"), "study.country"] <- "Vietnam"
fitCovariates[which(fitCovariates$study.country == "Lao People's Democratic Republic"), "study.country"] <- "Laos"
fitCovariates[which(fitCovariates$study.country == "Democratic People's Republic of Korea"), "study.country"] <- "North Korea"

fitCovariatesModelFit <- left_join(bactNotifStrat, fitCovariates) %>% 
                         group_by(Sex) %>% 
                         mutate(art.scld = scale(art_coverage), 
                                alcohol.scld = scale(`Alcohol use disorders`), 
                                hiv.aids.scld = scale(`HIV/AIDS`),
                                hiv.trtd.scld = scale(trtdHIV),
                                hiv.untrtd.scld = scale(untrtdHIV), 
                                diabetes.scld = scale(`Diabetes mellitus type 2`), 
                                bmi.scld = scale(bmi),
                                gdi.scld = scale(gdi),
                                uhc.scld = scale(UHCindex), 
                                smoking.scld = scale(smoking), 
                                symp.req = ifelse(is.na(symptomsRequired) & study.country == "Thailand", 
                                                  "Yes", symptomsRequired),
                                xpert.cult.used = XpertCultUsed) 

fitCovariatesNaRm <- fitCovariatesModelFit %>% 
                     select(logTbPrev, logTbPrevSE, logCalcNotifRate, 
                            Sex, study.country, id, year_z, #gdi.scld,
                            alcohol.scld, hiv.aids.scld, 
                            hiv.trtd.scld, hiv.untrtd.scld,
                            diabetes.scld, bmi.scld, uhc.scld, smoking.scld,
                            symp.req, xpert.cult.used) %>%
                     na.omit() %>% 
                     ###### Add an ID number #################
                     group_by(study.country, year_z) %>% 
                     mutate("id" = cur_group_id(), 
                     ###### Add in the negative prevalence and notifications for ratio 
                     logTbPrevNeg = logTbPrev *-1, 
                     logCalcNotifRateNeg = -1 * logCalcNotifRate)


lmics <- read.csv(here("data/LMIC2025.csv")) 

fitCovariates_lmic <- fitCovariates %>% 
                      filter(country.code %in% lmics$country.code) %>% 
                      ### Scale the covariates to meet model data 
                      mutate(alcohol.scld = (`Alcohol use disorders` - mean(fitCovariatesModelFit$`Alcohol use disorders`))/
                                            sd(fitCovariatesModelFit$`Alcohol use disorders`), 
                             hiv.aids.scld = (`HIV/AIDS` - mean(fitCovariatesModelFit$`HIV/AIDS`))/
                                            sd(fitCovariatesModelFit$`HIV/AIDS`),
                             hiv.trtd.scld = (trtdHIV - mean(fitCovariatesModelFit$trtdHIV))/
                                            sd(fitCovariatesModelFit$trtdHIV),
                             hiv.untrtd.scld = (untrtdHIV - mean(fitCovariatesModelFit$untrtdHIV))/
                                            sd(fitCovariatesModelFit$untrtdHIV),
                             diabetes.scld = (`Diabetes mellitus type 2` - mean(fitCovariatesModelFit$`Diabetes mellitus type 2`))/
                                            sd(fitCovariatesModelFit$`Diabetes mellitus type 2`),
                             smoking.scld = (smoking - mean(fitCovariatesModelFit$smoking))/
                                            sd(fitCovariatesModelFit$smoking),
                             bmi.scld = (bmi - mean(fitCovariatesModelFit$bmi, na.rm = TRUE))/
                                            sd(fitCovariatesModelFit$bmi, na.rm = TRUE),
                             uhc.scld = (UHCindex - mean(fitCovariatesModelFit$UHCindex, na.rm = TRUE))/
                                            sd(fitCovariatesModelFit$UHCindex, na.rm = TRUE)) 
# View(fitCovariates_lmic)
# View(fitCovariates)
# View(fitCovariates %>% filter(is.na(art_coverage))%>% select(study.country, iso3, study.end.year, art_coverage))
```

```{r univariate models (internal), echo = FALSE,  warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide"}
                              1 + Sex + (1 + Sex | study.country) +# (1 + Sex | id) +
                               Sex*offset(logCalcNotifRateNeg)  + Sex*xpert.cult.used,
                    data = fitCovariatesNaRm,
                    prior = c(prior(normal(0,1), class = Intercept),
                              prior(normal(0,1), class = b),
                              prior(cauchy(0,1), class = sd),
                              prior(cauchy(0,1), class = sigma),
                              prior(lkj(10), class=cor)),
                    family = gaussian(),
                    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                    chains = 4,
                    cores = 4,
                    iter = 10000, warmup = 2500, thin=3, seed = npSeed)


summary(model10c_xpertCult)
```

### Run multivariate model with offset notification predictor

```{r multivariate np ratio model, echo = FALSE,  warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide"}
modelAllOffset <- brms::brm(formula = logTbPrevNeg | se(logTbPrevSE, sigma=TRUE) ~ 
                              1 + Sex + (1 + Sex | study.country) + #(1 + Sex | id) + 
                              Sex*year_z +
                              Sex*offset(logCalcNotifRateNeg) + 
                              Sex*alcohol.scld +
                              Sex*diabetes.scld +
                              Sex*hiv.trtd.scld +
                              Sex*hiv.untrtd.scld +
                              Sex*smoking.scld +
                              Sex*bmi.scld +
                              Sex*uhc.scld +
                              Sex*symp.req +
                              Sex*xpert.cult.used,
                    data = fitCovariatesNaRm %>% 
                           mutate(logTbPrevNeg = logTbPrev *-1, 
                                  logCalcNotifRateNeg = -1 * logCalcNotifRate), 
                    prior = c(prior(normal(0,1), class = Intercept),
                              prior(normal(0,1), class = b),
                              prior(cauchy(0,1), class = sd),
                              prior(cauchy(0,1), class = sigma),
                              prior(lkj(10), class=cor)),
                    family = gaussian(),
                    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                    chains = 4,
                    cores = 4,
                    iter = 10000, warmup = 2500, thin=3, seed = npSeed)

summary(modelAllOffset)
```

## Prediction

### Predict to included LMICs with covariate data in 2024/5 (all covariates)
```{r}
lmicData23 <- left_join(fitCovariates_lmic, 
                      notifStrat %>% rename(study.country = country, 
                                            study.end.year = year)) %>% 
            mutate(year_z = study.end.year - mean(study.end.year)) %>% 
            filter(study.end.year == 2023) %>% 
            filter(study.country %in% fitCovariatesNaRm$study.country)

lmicEst <- modelAllPred %>%
           add_epred_draws(newdata = lmicData23 %>%  
                                     mutate(logTbPrevSE = 0, 
                                            symp.req = "No", 
                                            xpert.cult.used = "Yes"),
                           re_formula =  ~ 1 + Sex + (1 + Sex | study.country),
                           allow_new_levels=TRUE) %>%
           ungroup() %>% 
           mutate(label = paste(study.country, study.end.year)) %>% 
           dplyr::select(label, study.country, country.code, Sex, .draw, .epred, calcNotifRate) %>%
           mutate(prev = exp(.epred), 
                  npRatio = calcNotifRate / prev); #lmicEst
  
### Country-level estimates of npRatio
lmicNPratio <- lmicEst %>% 
    group_by(Sex, study.country, country.code) %>%
    mean_qi(npRatio, width = 0.95) ; lmicNPratio

### Country-level estimates of prevalence by sex 
lmicPrev <- lmicEst %>% 
    group_by(Sex, study.country, country.code) %>%
    mean_qi(prev, width = 0.95)%>% 
    mutate(formattedPrev = paste0(round(prev*1e5), " (", round(prev.lower*1e5), ", ", round(prev.upper*1e5), ")")); 

#### Total prevalence by sex 
lmicPrev %>% summarise(totalPrev = sum(prev)*1e5, .by="Sex")
```

```{r}
lmicMF <- ((lmicEst %>% 
                ungroup() %>%
                na.omit() %>% 
                filter(Sex == "male") %>% 
                select(prev)) / 
                (lmicEst %>% 
            ungroup() %>%                
                na.omit() %>% 
                filter(Sex == "female") %>% 
                select(prev)) )%>% 
                rename(mfRatio = prev) 

lmicMF %>% mean_qi()                 
```

### Prevalence by sex 

```{r}

lmicPrevN <- left_join(lmicEst %>% 
             #group_by(Sex, study.country, country.code)
    
             select(study.country, Sex, prev, .draw), 
                       sexPop %>% 
                       filter(year == 2023) %>% 
                       select(! year) %>%
                       rename(study.country = country) %>% 
                       pivot_longer(cols = c(pop_male, pop_female), 
                                    values_to = "population", names_prefix = "pop_", 
                                    names_to = "Sex")) %>% 
              mutate(Prev.Est = prev*population) %>% 
              reframe(total.prev = sum(Prev.Est, na.rm=TRUE), .by = c(.draw, Sex)) %>% 
    group_by(Sex) %>% 
    mean_qi(total.prev) %>% select(Sex, total.prev, .lower, .upper) 

lmicPrevN %>% mutate(total.prev = round(total.prev/1e6,2),
                     .lower = round(.lower/1e6,2),
                     .upper = round(.upper/1e6,2))


lmicPrevN2 <- left_join(lmicEst %>% 
             #group_by(Sex, study.country, country.code)
    
             select(study.country, Sex, prev, .draw), 
                       sexPop %>% 
                       filter(year == 2023) %>% 
                       select(! year) %>%
                       rename(study.country = country) %>% 
                       pivot_longer(cols = c(pop_male, pop_female), 
                                    values_to = "population", names_prefix = "pop_", 
                                    names_to = "Sex")) %>% 
              mutate(Prev.Est = prev*population) %>% 
              reframe(total.prev = sum(Prev.Est, na.rm=TRUE), .by = c(.draw, Sex))  %>%
              pivot_wider(id_cols=.draw, names_from = Sex, values_from = total.prev) %>%
              mutate(mfRatio = male/female) %>%
              mean_qi(mfRatio); lmicPrevN2
```

## Predict to all LMICs with covariate data for all available years (2000 onward)

### Join covariates and prediction for figures 

```{r}
lmicDataAllYr <- left_join(fitCovariates_lmic, 
                           notifStrat %>% rename(study.country = country, 
                                                 study.end.year = year)) %>% 
                          mutate(year_z = study.end.year - 2013) 


lmicDataAllYrTrunc <- left_join(fitCovariates_lmic, 
                      notifStrat %>% rename(study.country = country, 
                                            study.end.year = year)) %>% 
                      mutate(year_z = as.numeric(study.end.year) - 2013, 
                              alcohol.scld = ifelse(alcohol.scld > max(fitCovariatesNaRm$alcohol.scld), max(fitCovariatesNaRm$alcohol.scld), ifelse(alcohol.scld < min(fitCovariatesNaRm$alcohol.scld), min(fitCovariatesNaRm$alcohol.scld), alcohol.scld)), 
                              diabetes.scld = ifelse(diabetes.scld > max(fitCovariatesNaRm$diabetes.scld), max(fitCovariatesNaRm$diabetes.scld), ifelse(diabetes.scld < min(fitCovariatesNaRm$diabetes.scld), min(fitCovariatesNaRm$diabetes.scld), diabetes.scld)), 
                              hiv.trtd.scld = ifelse(hiv.trtd.scld > max(fitCovariatesNaRm$hiv.trtd.scld), max(fitCovariatesNaRm$hiv.trtd.scld), ifelse(hiv.trtd.scld < min(fitCovariatesNaRm$hiv.trtd.scld), min(fitCovariatesNaRm$hiv.trtd.scld), hiv.trtd.scld)), 
                              hiv.untrtd.scld = ifelse(hiv.untrtd.scld > max(fitCovariatesNaRm$hiv.untrtd.scld), max(fitCovariatesNaRm$hiv.untrtd.scld), ifelse(hiv.untrtd.scld < min(fitCovariatesNaRm$hiv.untrtd.scld), min(fitCovariatesNaRm$hiv.untrtd.scld), hiv.untrtd.scld)), 
                              smoking.scld = ifelse(smoking.scld > max(fitCovariatesNaRm$smoking.scld), max(fitCovariatesNaRm$smoking.scld), ifelse(smoking.scld < min(fitCovariatesNaRm$smoking.scld), min(fitCovariatesNaRm$smoking.scld), smoking.scld)), 
                              bmi.scld = ifelse(bmi.scld > max(fitCovariatesNaRm$bmi.scld), max(fitCovariatesNaRm$bmi.scld), ifelse(bmi.scld < min(fitCovariatesNaRm$bmi.scld), min(fitCovariatesNaRm$bmi.scld), bmi.scld)), 
                              uhc.scld = ifelse(uhc.scld > max(fitCovariatesNaRm$uhc.scld), max(fitCovariatesNaRm$uhc.scld), ifelse(uhc.scld < min(fitCovariatesNaRm$uhc.scld), min(fitCovariatesNaRm$uhc.scld), uhc.scld)),
                             logCalcNotifRate = ifelse(logCalcNotifRate > max(fitCovariatesNaRm$logCalcNotifRate), max(fitCovariatesNaRm$logCalcNotifRate), ifelse(logCalcNotifRate < min(fitCovariatesNaRm$logCalcNotifRate), min(fitCovariatesNaRm$logCalcNotifRate), logCalcNotifRate)))
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.height = 8, fig.width =11}
lmicAllYrEst <- modelAllPred %>%
                add_epred_draws(newdata = lmicDataAllYr %>%

                mutate(label = paste(study.country, study.end.year)) %>%
```

### Plot the sex-stratified prevalence across time
```{r}
lmicPrevAllYr0 <-   lmicAllYrEst %>%
                    summarize(totalPrev = sum(prevN, na.rm = TRUE), 
                              totalPop = sum(pop, na.rm = TRUE), 
                              totalNotif = sum(calcCases, na.rm = TRUE),
                              .by = c(.draw, Sex, study.end.year)) %>%
                    na.omit()

    group_by(Sex, study.end.year) %>% 
    mean_qi(totalPrev, width = 0.95)

    geom_point(aes(x=study.end.year, y=totalPrev, color = Sex)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(x=study.end.year, ymin=totalPrev.lower,
```

### Predict to all LMICs with covariate data for all available years (2000 onward) using only year model
```{r}
lmicDataAllYr <- left_join(fitCovariates_lmic, 
                      notifStrat %>% rename(study.country = country, 
                                            study.end.year = year)) %>% 
            filter(study.country %in% bactModelNatDF$study.country) %>% 
                mutate(year_z = study.end.year - 2013) 


modelPredYr <- brms::brm(formula = logTbPrev | se(logTbPrevSE, sigma=TRUE) ~
                              1 + Sex + (1 + Sex * year_z | study.country) + 
                              Sex* + Sex*year_z + Sex*logCalcNotifRate,
                    data = fitCovariatesNaRm,
                    prior = c(prior(normal(0,1), class = Intercept),
                              prior(normal(0,1), class = b),
                              prior(cauchy(0,1), class = sd),
                              prior(cauchy(0,1), class = sigma),
                              prior(lkj(10), class=cor)),
                    family = gaussian(),
                    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                    chains = 4,
                    cores = 4,
                    iter = 10000, warmup = 2500, thin=3)


lmicAllYrEstSimp <- modelPredYr %>%
                add_epred_draws(newdata = lmicDataAllYr %>%
                                         mutate(logTbPrevSE = 0),
                               re_formula =  ~ 1 + Sex + Sex*year_z + (1 + Sex * year_z | study.country),
                               allow_new_levels=TRUE) %>%
                ungroup() %>%
                mutate(label = paste(study.country, study.end.year)) %>%
                dplyr::select(label, study.country, country.code, study.end.year, 
                              calcCases, pop, 
                              Sex, .draw, .epred, calcNotifRate) %>%
                mutate(prevRate = exp(.epred), 
                       prevN = prevRate * pop, 
                       npRatio2 = calcCases / prevN, 
                       npRatio = calcNotifRate / prevRate)
  
lmicPrevAllYrSimp0 <- lmicAllYrEstSimp %>%
    summarize(totalPrev = sum(prevN), 
              totalPop = sum(pop), 
              totalNotif = sum(calcCases),
              .by = c(.draw, Sex, study.end.year)) %>%
    na.omit() 

lmicPrevAllYrSimp <- lmicPrevAllYrSimp0  %>%
    group_by(Sex, study.end.year) %>% 
    mean_qi(totalPrev, width = 0.95) 

# lmicNPratioAllYrSimp <- lmicAllYrEstSimp %>% 
#     group_by(Sex, study.end.year) %>%
#     na.omit() %>% 
#     mean_qi(npRatio, width = 0.95) ; lmicNPratioAllYrSimp


ggplot(lmicPrevAllYrSimp %>% filter(study.end.year != 2024)) + 
    geom_point(aes(x=study.end.year, y=totalPrev, color = Sex)) + 
    geom_ribbon(aes(x=study.end.year, ymin=totalPrev.lower, ymax=totalPrev.upper, fill = Sex), alpha = 0.5) +
                    theme_minimal() + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c("darkred", "dodgerblue4")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkred", "dodgerblue4")) +
    facet_wrap(facets = vars(Sex)) + ylab("TB Prevalence all countries (year only)") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") + 
    ggtitle("TB Prevalence all countries for all countries (year only)")

lmicPrevRateAllYrSimp <- lmicPrevAllYrSimp0 %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(prevRateCalc = totalPrev/totalPop*1e5) %>%
    group_by(Sex, study.end.year) %>% 
    mean_qi(prevRateCalc, width = 0.95) 

ggplot(lmicPrevRateAllYrSimp %>% filter(study.end.year != 2024)) +
    geom_point(aes(x=study.end.year, y=prevRateCalc, color = Sex)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(x=study.end.year, ymin=prevRateCalc.lower, ymax=prevRateCalc.upper, fill = Sex), alpha = 0.5) +
                    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("darkred", "dodgerblue4")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkred", "dodgerblue4")) +
    facet_wrap(facets = vars(Sex)) + ylab("TB prevalence rate (per 100K)") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") + ylim(0,2250) + 
    ggtitle("TB prevalence rate (per 100K) for all countries (year only)")

lmicNPAllYrSimp <- lmicPrevAllYrSimp0 %>%
                ungroup() %>% 
                mutate(npRatio = totalNotif / totalPrev) %>%
                group_by(Sex, study.end.year) %>% 
                mean_qi(npRatio, width = 0.95) 

ggplot(lmicNPAllYrSimp %>% filter(study.end.year != 2024)) +
    geom_point(aes(x=study.end.year, y=npRatio, color = Sex)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(x=study.end.year, ymin=npRatio.lower, ymax=npRatio.upper, fill = Sex), alpha = 0.5) +
                    theme_minimal() + ylim(0,1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("darkred", "dodgerblue4")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkred", "dodgerblue4")) +
    facet_wrap(facets = vars(Sex)) + ylab("Notification to Prevalence Ratio") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") + 
    ggtitle("Notification to Prevalence Ratio for all countries (year only)")
```

## SMEAR POSITIVE ANALYSIS 

who uses smear positive so let's try that 

```{r, echo = FALSE,  warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
cleanSexSmrDF0 <- smrPosIndicator("sex") %>% 
                  filter(sex.smr.analysis.indicator !="none",
                  study.geography == "Nationally representative")  

##############################################################################|
##### CREATE A TIDY DATASET OF RELEVANT VARIABLES #############################
cleanSexSmrDF <- cleanSexSmrDF0 %>% 
                 mutate("id" = row_number(),
                        ### We have a lower ci of zero so replace with super small non-zero number
                        adj.prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.female = ifelse(
                                            adj.prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.female == 0, 
                                            1e-4, 
                                            adj.prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.female
                        )) %>%
                 ### Scale all prevalence estimates back to decimals 
                 mutate_at(vars(matches('prev100k.smear.positive.tb.|prev100k.ci.([a-z]{3})er.smear.positive.tb.')),  ~ (. / 1e5)) %>% 
                 select(id,
                       covidence.id, 
                       figure.id.yr, 
                       study.geography, 
                       title.extracted,
                       study.country,
                       WHO.region,
                       study.start.year, 
                       study.end.year, 
                       publication.year,
                       study.quality.summary,
                       screening.tests,
                       bacteriological.tb.definition, 
                       xpert.samples, xpert.used, other.xpert.samples,
                       culture.samples, culture.used, other.culture.samples,
                       participants.sputum.collected,
                       ends_with("male"), ends_with("sex"),
                       sex.smr.analysis.indicator) %>%
    
    mutate("tbPrevSmr.male" =  case_when(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "adj.prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ adj.prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male,
                                       sex.smr.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male, 
                                       sex.smr.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "n.smear.positive.tb" ~ n.smear.positive.tb.male/n.participants.male,
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "prev100k.smear.positive.tb" ~ prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male),
           "tbPrevSmr.female" = case_when(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == 
                                            "adj.prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ adj.prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female,
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator == 
                                            "prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female, 
                                       sex.smr.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "n.smear.positive.tb" ~ n.smear.positive.tb.female/n.participants.female,
                                       sex.smr.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "prev100k.smear.positive.tb" ~ prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female),
           logTbPrevSmr.male = log(tbPrevSmr.male), 
           logTbPrevSmr.female = log(tbPrevSmr.female)) %>%

    #### Create a confidence interval for those without 
    #### these are using the wilson method with continuity correction
    #### cannot seem to get case_when to work so this is going to be verbose bc deadline
    
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(calc.ci.lower.male = ifelse(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "n.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(n.smear.positive.tb.male, n.participants.male))$conf.int[1],
                                        ifelse(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male*n.participants.male, n.participants.male))$conf.int[1], 
                                              NA)),
            calc.ci.upper.male = ifelse(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "n.smear.positive.tb",
                                        (prop.test(n.smear.positive.tb.male, n.participants.male))$conf.int[2],
                                  ifelse(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male*n.participants.male, n.participants.male))$conf.int[2], 
                                              NA)),
           calc.ci.lower.female = ifelse(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "n.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(n.smear.positive.tb.female, n.participants.female))$conf.int[1],
                                  ifelse(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female*n.participants.female, n.participants.female))$conf.int[1], 
                                              NA)),
            calc.ci.upper.female = ifelse(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "n.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(n.smear.positive.tb.female, n.participants.female))$conf.int[2],
                                   ifelse(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female*n.participants.female, n.participants.female))$conf.int[2], 
                                              NA))) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate("tbPrevSmrSE.male" = case_when(
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "adj.prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb"  ~ 
                                         (adj.prev100k.ci.upper.smear.positive.tb.male -
                                                                 adj.prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.male)/3.92,
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ 
                                            (prev100k.ci.upper.smear.positive.tb.male -
                                                                 prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.male)/3.92,
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator %in% c("n.smear.positive.tb", 
                                                                      "prev100k.smear.positive.tb")  ~ 
                                            (calc.ci.upper.male - calc.ci.lower.male)/3.92),
           "tbPrevSmrSE.female" =  case_when(
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "adj.prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb"  ~ 
                                         (adj.prev100k.ci.upper.smear.positive.tb.female -
                                                                 adj.prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.female)/3.92,

                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ 
                                            (prev100k.ci.upper.smear.positive.tb.female - 
                                                                 prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.female)/3.92,
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator %in% c("n.smear.positive.tb", 
                                                                      "prev100k.smear.positive.tb")  ~ 
                                                        (calc.ci.upper.male - calc.ci.lower.male)/3.92),
           "logTbPrevSmrSE.male" = case_when(
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "adj.prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb"  ~ 
                                         log(adj.prev100k.ci.upper.smear.positive.tb.male /
                                                                 adj.prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.male)/3.92,
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ 
                                            log(prev100k.ci.upper.smear.positive.tb.male /
                                                                 prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.male)/3.92,
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator %in% c("n.smear.positive.tb", 
                                                                      "prev100k.smear.positive.tb")  ~ 
                                            log(calc.ci.upper.male / calc.ci.lower.male)/3.92),
           "logTbPrevSmrSE.female" =  case_when(
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "adj.prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb"  ~ 
                                         log(adj.prev100k.ci.upper.smear.positive.tb.female /
                                                                 adj.prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.female)/3.92,

                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ 
                                            log(prev100k.ci.upper.smear.positive.tb.female / 
                                                                 prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.female)/3.92,
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator %in% c("n.smear.positive.tb", 
                                                                      "prev100k.smear.positive.tb")  ~ 
                                                        log(calc.ci.upper.male / calc.ci.lower.male)/3.92)) %>% 
     pivot_longer(cols = c(tbPrevSmr.male, tbPrevSmr.female,
                              logTbPrevSmr.male, logTbPrevSmr.female, 
                              logTbPrevSmrSE.male, logTbPrevSmrSE.female), 
                 names_to = c("Measure","Sex"), 
                 names_pattern = "(.*)\\.(.*)$", 
                 ) %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = Measure, values_from = value) %>% 
                                mutate(natRep = ifelse(is.na(study.geography), 
                                                       NA, 
                                                       ifelse(study.geography == "Nationally representative", 
                                                       "Yes", "No")),
                                       ## preserve the extracted study end year
                                       study.end.year.ext = study.end.year, 
                                       ## update missing study end year to be publication year - mean lag
                                       study.end.year = ifelse(!is.na(study.end.year), 
                                                               study.end.year.ext, 
                                                               publication.year - meanLag),
                                       ## Mean center year for temporal analysis
                                       year_z = study.end.year - round(mean(study.end.year, na.rm=TRUE)),

                                       bias= ifelse(grepl("Low", study.quality.summary), "Low", "Not low"),
                                       
                                       symptomScreen = ifelse(is.na(screening.tests), 
                                                                    NA, 
                                                                    ifelse(grepl("Symptom", 
                                                                    screening.tests, 
                                                                    ignore.case=TRUE), "Yes", "No")),
                                       symptomsRequired = ifelse(is.na(participants.sputum.collected) | grepl("unknown", 
                                                                                                              participants.sputum.collected,ignore.case=TRUE), 
                                                                       NA, 
                                                                       ifelse(!grepl("x-ray|all participants|other",
                                                                        participants.sputum.collected,ignore.case=TRUE),
                                                                 "Yes", "No")),

                                       WHO.region = gsub("\\(WHO\\)", "region", WHO.region)) 

##############################################################################|
#### Dataset for modeling #####################################################
##############################################################################|
#### Calculate the variance adjustment for non-adjusted studies
varAdjPR <- varianceAdjust("sex")


smrModelNatDF1 <- cleanSexSmrDF %>%  
    select(id, WHO.region, study.country, study.end.year, 
sex.smr.analysis.indicator,
Sex, tbPrevSmr, 
           logTbPrevSmr, logTbPrevSmrSE,
           symptomsRequired,
           bias, 
           n.participants.male, n.participants.female, 
           bias, publication.year, year_z) 

smrModelNatDF <- cleanSexSmrDF %>%  
    select(id, WHO.region, study.country, study.end.year, 
           sex.smr.analysis.indicator, Sex, tbPrevSmr,
           logTbPrevSmr, logTbPrevSmrSE,
           symptomsRequired,
           bias, 
           n.participants.male, n.participants.female, 
           bias, publication.year, year_z) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(id, WHO.region, study.country, study.end.year, 
           symptomsRequired, sex.smr.analysis.indicator,
            bias, 
           n.participants.male, n.participants.female, 
           bias, publication.year, year_z), 
                names_from = Sex,
                values_from = c(tbPrevSmr, logTbPrevSmr, logTbPrevSmrSE),
                names_sep = "_") %>%
    mutate(logPR = logTbPrevSmr_male - logTbPrevSmr_female,
           unadj_logPR_se = sqrt(logTbPrevSmrSE_male^2 + logTbPrevSmrSE_female^2), 
           log_PR_se = ifelse(grepl("adj", sex.smr.analysis.indicator), 
                                     unadj_logPR_se,
                                     ifelse(grepl("smear", sex.smr.analysis.indicator),
                                         sqrt(`unadj_logPR_se`^2 + varAdj["Smear Variance Median"]),
                                         sqrt(`unadj_logPR_se`^2 + varAdj["Bact Variance Median"]))))


#### Add in notifications
smrNotifStrat2 <- left_join(smrModelNatDF1, smrNotifStrat, 
                            by = c("study.country", "study.end.year", "Sex"))# %>%
    # mutate(id = )

View(smrNotifStrat2)

```


### Model 3: prevalence with notification as a covariate 

```{r}
model3 <- brms::brm(formula = logTbPrevSmr | se(logTbPrevSmrSE, sigma=TRUE) ~ 
                           1 + Sex + (1 + Sex | study.country) + (1 + Sex | id) + smrNotifRate,
                       data = smrNotifStrat2 %>% filter(!is.na(smrNotifRate)) %>% 
                              mutate("id" = row_number()),
                       prior = prior(student_t(7, 0, 1.5), class = Intercept) +
                               prior(normal(0, 1), class = b) +
                               prior(exponential(2), class = sd) +
                               prior(exponential(4), class = sigma) +
                               prior(lkj(4), class=cor),
                       
                       family = gaussian(),
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                       chains = 4,
                       cores = 4,
                       iter = 10000, warmup = 2500, thin=3)


### coefficients
summary(model3)

### create model estimates 
survey_mod3_est <-  model3 %>% 
    add_epred_draws(newdata = smrNotifStrat2 %>% filter(!is.na(smrNotifRate)) %>% 
                              mutate("id" = row_number()) %>%  
                              mutate(logTbPrevSE = 0),
                    re_formula =  ~ 1 + Sex + (1 + Sex | study.country) + (1 + Sex | id) + smrNotifRate, 
                    allow_new_levels=TRUE) %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(label = paste(study.country, study.end.year)) %>% 
    dplyr::select(label, study.country, id, Sex, smrNotifRate, .draw, .epred) %>%
    group_by(Sex, id, study.country) %>%  
    mutate(tbPrevSmr = exp(.epred) * 1e5, 
           pnRatio = exp(.epred) / smrNotifRate) %>% 
    select(!smrNotifRate)

### Create summary statistics 
survey_mod3_summary <- 
    survey_mod3_est %>%
    group_by(Sex, study.country, id, label) %>%
    mean_qi(tbPrevSmr, na.rm=T) %>% 
    mutate(across(c(tbPrevSmr, .lower, .upper), 
                  round, 2)); survey_mod3_summary

survey_mod3_pn_summary <- 
    survey_mod3_est %>%
    group_by(Sex, study.country, id, label) %>%
    mean_qi(pnRatio, na.rm=T) %>% 
    mutate(across(c(pnRatio, .lower, .upper), 
                  round, 2)); survey_mod3_pn_summary
```
